rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the remaining work is extensions behind existing interfaces rather than a spread of shallow wrappers: the catalogue is data consumed by `load_machine_map`; the EQDB read is one request kind on `RemoteEddbExtractor` (which already hides batch framing, the per-request refusal contract and the niced ssh command); the grid record is a sibling writer of `write_channel` in `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py` sharing `EDDB_TOKEN_ATTR`/`_channel_present`/overwrite refusal; the SELENE comparator nests in `efit_referee.judge_geometry` and `runner._magnetics_residual`. The one new public callable, `export_tokamap_directory`, hides the unit×sign×COCOS collapse behind a single entry point.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — each shared concern is routed to its named owner to extend, not forked: placement/path resolution to `imas_ambix/data/paths.py`; machine selection to `imas_ambix/gs/machine_selection.py` (`ArtifactMachineSelector`) and `gs/machine_identity.py` (`identity_for_shot`); the shot→machine declaration to `imas_ambix/spine_bench/shots.py` (`BenchShot.machine`, already landed); EDDB transport/store to `eddb_remote.py`/`eddb.py`; geometry resolution to `gs/artifact_resolution.py`; the machine pin constants to a machine-keyed table in that same file. The plan explicitly reconciles the netCDF source-layer store against the content-addressed artifact store instead of adding a second resolver ("not a second machine-description artifact store").
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that widens surface accounts for it in its own text: §2 "retires nothing, because ambix has no exporter"; §4 "widens one protocol method and retires nothing" and "the slot widens one binding contract and retires nothing"; §5 "adds one data file and no public definition or refusal family"; §6 "retires nothing public, because every existing name keeps its caller"; §7 "retires nothing, because no equilibrium-database reader exists in ambix" and "adds two record fields and retires nothing".
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every remaining mechanism names the existing owner it extends and the file is real: §2 `export_tokamap_directory` in `imas_ambix/data/tokamap_export.py`; §4 `StoreEngine.open` in `imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py`, `read_geometry_table`/`_supply_declared_probe_angles` in `imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py`, roots via `imas_ambix/data/paths.py`; §5 `load_packaged_signal_map` in `imas_ambix/data/signal_map.py`; §6 `score_convention` in `imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py` and `judge_geometry`/`measure_diiid_convention` in `imas_ambix/eval/efit_referee.py`+`imas_ambix/challenge/convention.py`; §7 `RemoteEddbExtractor`/`eddb.py`, `resolve_machine_description`, `ArtifactMachineSelector`, `spine_bench/shots.py`, `_magnetics_residual` in `spine_bench/runner.py`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each layer over existing machinery states why the machinery cannot be extended instead: §2's exporter stays out of the loaders "because they read the ambix schema and must not learn tokamap's"; §5's normalisation file is "a spelling map, not a second conversion mechanism", leaving conversion with `signal_map.py` and `tokamap_export._unit_factor`; §4/§7 extend `StoreEngine.open` and `RemoteEddbExtractor` "rather than adding one"/"rather than sitting beside it".
